test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which group of the following metals are obtained by reduction using carbon?

Na, Zn, Ca, Pb, Mg, Fe, Al, Cu, Ag
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zn, Fe, Cu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zinc (Zn):** Obtained from zinc oxide (ZnO) using carbon.
 
• **Iron (Fe):** Extracted from iron ore (Fe2O3 or Fe3O4) using carbon in a blast furnace.
 
• **Copper (Cu)**: Obtained from copper oxide (CuO) using carbon.
 
• **Atomic no. of Zn, Fe and Cu is 30,26,29 **respectively.
